title: Biomarker
description: A non-variant biomarker measurement: tumor mutational burden, microsatellite instability, mismatch-repair status, homologous-recombination deficiency, PD-L1 expression, hormone-receptor IHC, or other categorical/continuous tumor measurements that drive therapy selection. Each Biomarker maps to a FHIR Observation; LOINC codes are provided where standardized.

biomarkerId.description: Stable UUID for this biomarker measurement within this NGS interpretation response.

type.description: Biomarker class. 'mmr' covers four-protein IHC (MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2); 'msi' covers PCR or NGS-based MSI status; 'tmb' covers mutations per megabase from sequencing; 'pd-l1' covers any antibody clone (clone is captured separately).

loincCode.description: LOINC code identifying this measurement (e.g., '94076-7' for TMB by NGS, '81695-9' for MSI in cancer specimen by molecular genetics, '85319-2' for HER2 by IHC).

method.description: Measurement method. NGS-based TMB and IHC-based PD-L1 are not interchangeable: clones, thresholds, and accuracy differ.

value.description: Quantitative value when applicable (e.g., 24 for TMB in mut/Mb; 0.13 for tumor fraction). String when the source report supplies only a qualitative grade (e.g., 'High').

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., 'mut/Mb' for TMB, '%' for percentage scores, null for categorical biomarkers).

interpretation.description: Clinical interpretation as reported. The pipeline normalizes vendor labels (e.g., 'MSI-H', 'High', 'Unstable') to a single closed set.

threshold.description: Reference threshold or cutoff used for interpretation, when reported.

antibodyClone.description: For IHC biomarkers (esp. PD-L1, HER2, ER, PR, Ki-67), the antibody clone used (e.g., 'SP142', '22C3', 'SP263', '28-8'). Different clones for the same target produce non-interchangeable results.

scoringSystem.description: For PD-L1 specifically: 'TPS', 'CPS', 'IC' (immune cell), 'TC' (tumor cell). For HER2: 'IHC 0/1+/2+/3+', 'ISH ratio'. For ER/PR: 'Allred score', 'percent positive nuclei'.

score.description: Free-form score string when the result is a graded label rather than a numeric value (e.g., '3+, 100%' for an IHC score; 'IHC 2+ / FISH-amplified').

externalLevels.description: Optional map of proprietary or third-party evidence levels keyed by knowledge-base identifier (e.g., {"civic": "A"}). Use only with appropriate licensing for the referenced knowledge base. The open-source schema does not prescribe values for any particular KB.

evidence.description: Evidence-tier metadata. AMP/ASCO/CAP 2017 is the public taxonomy carried in the open contract. Proprietary or third-party levels go in externalLevels keyed by knowledge-base name; obtain appropriate licensing before populating it.
